title: Ranges and NOT in sales · part 5

steps.title: Keep total from 721.56 to 728.55
steps.prompt:
BETWEEN lo AND hi keeps a range (both ends included).
It is a tidy way to write two comparisons at once.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE total BETWEEN …
Write the two ends with AND between them.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55;
steps.memory_trick: BETWEEN a AND b = a <= x <= b.

steps.title: Keep total outside 721.56..728.55
steps.prompt: NOT flips a test: NOT (something) means 'the opposite'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE NOT (total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Wrap the range in brackets after NOT.
NOT ( total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55 ).
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE NOT (total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE NOT (total BETWEEN 721.56 AND 728.55);
steps.memory_trick: NOT reverses whatever is inside the brackets.
